summary: Douglas Christensen, 53, of Castle Pines, fell ~30 ft while descending Windom Peak (14,089 ft) in the Chicago Basin area of the Weminuche Wilderness. A climbing partner and a passerby attempted CPR at the scene without success. Storms prevented aerial recovery Monday; conditions allowed his body to be removed Tuesday via helicopter long-line extraction.
wx_note: Pinned to county centroid (Durango). Responding agency not named in article; info sourced to La Plata County government.
